title: Irreproducible result
body: Great work! I also enjoyed talking to the last author in CoRL 2025. There are some issues I want to resolve. I want to reproduce the figure below. The pixel-based policy code seems off in many way. 1) The pretrained base policies achieve **0%** success rates for Robomimic's tasks; lift, square, can 2) The finetuning doesn't improve at all, which makese sense, because the base policy has 0% success rate. 3) The image observation used seems off. Look below: 4) The policy here is using only wrist camera image as image observation, but is this mistake? I think people use multi-view images in this kind of manipulation setting, which often includes frontal view images. 5) The state-observation policy's "square" task checkpoint has mismatch problem with the model config, and after I fix it by doing ``` time_dim: 16 mlp_dims: [512, 512, 512] # cond_mlp_dims: [512, 64]` ``` in `cfg/robomimic/eval/square/eval_diffusion_mlp.yaml`, I can finally run evaluation but I get 0% success rate. Overall, I think the robomimic tasks and pixel-based policy release are not ready. There were many minor bugs too. - rgb observation shape issue after resetting - Wrong class name `Error locating target 'model.diffusion.diffusion_eval_ft.DiffusionEval', set env var HYDRA_FULL_ERROR=1 to see chained exception.` Looking forward to hearing clarification!
